whatItIs: NaturesMud Pumpkin Seeds (300 GM value pack) are AA/AAA-grade, hull-less emerald-green pumpkin seed kernels (pepitas). Unfried, unsalted, and unbleached, they are one of nature’s richest whole-food sources of dietary magnesium, zinc, iron, and plant protein (30g protein per 100g).
nepaliKitchenUses: Daily Handful or Light Pan-Toast: Eat 1–2 tablespoons (20g) raw, or dry-roast in a pan for 2 minutes until they pop and turn nutty.
Morning Oats, Dahi & Salad Crunch: Scatter over morning oatmeal, curd bowls, cucumber salads, or avocado toast.
Homemade Seed Butter & Pesto: Blend toasted Pumpkin Seeds with garlic, coriander/basil, lemon juice, and olive/coconut oil for a dairy-free green chutney.
Baby & Toddler Nut/Seed Powder (8M+): Dry-roast and grind into a fine powder with Almonds and Makhana to fortify toddler porridge (as advised by your pediatrician).
whoItSuits: Ideal for men and women seeking natural dietary zinc and magnesium, gym-goers wanting plant protein, students, and families building daily seed-cycling or trail-mix jars.
monsoonStorage: Raw pumpkin seeds contain delicate polyunsaturated oils that can turn rancid if stored in hot kitchens. Keep the pack tightly sealed in a cool cupboard or inside the refrigerator during warm summer and monsoon months.

faqs.q: Should I eat Pumpkin Seeds raw, soaked, or roasted?
faqs.a: You can eat them raw straight from the pack, soak them for 4–6 hours, or lightly dry-roast them in a pan on low heat for 2–3 minutes until slightly puffed and aromatic.

faqs.q: How much Pumpkin Seeds should I eat per day?
faqs.a: A daily serving of 1 to 2 tablespoons (about 15g to 25g) provides a rich boost of natural magnesium, zinc, and plant protein.

faqs.q: Why are these Pumpkin Seeds green without white shells?
faqs.a: These are hull-less green pepita kernels—so there is no hard white outer shell to peel, and 100% of the seed is edible.

faqs.q: How do I keep Pumpkin Seeds fresh for months?
faqs.a: Seal the pack tightly after each use and store in a cool, dark place or in the refrigerator to protect their natural seed oils.
